title: checklist.selectors.json (M3.2)
description: Optional sidecar file for the UI lane. Hand-authored or future-tool-emitted, it maps checklist step IDs to structured Chrome MCP actions. Steps not listed fall back to Chrome MCP find() at runtime, so partial coverage is fine.

generator.description: Free-form identifier of whatever emitted the file — a script version, a tool name, or 'hand-authored'. Informational.

coverage.description: Diagnostic — how many steps the generator could resolve.

steps.description: Keyed by step ID (e.g. 'p0-1-step-3'). Missing keys mean 'no deterministic selector available — qa-ui-executor falls back to Chrome MCP find() at runtime'.

selector.description: CSS selector or attribute query, e.g. '[data-testid=publish-schedule-button]' or 'button:has-text("Save & Publish")'. Prefer data-testid where the codebase has them.

url.description: For 'navigate' actions. Relative path, prepended to the deploy URL by the executor.

text.description: For 'wait_for_text', 'assert_present', 'assert_absent'. May be a regex if wrapped in / / pattern.

rationale.description: One-line why-this-action (helps debugging when the action doesn't match expectations).

p0-1-step-3.rationale: Asserting no double-encoded characters in the downloaded CSV.
